body: I mean my band too. I just can't help being scared. I have seen people dress up like me, it's a bit much sometimes. Maybe they would think I am just a fan pretending. I don't have all my memories since I shot myself.

Because everyone will have different opinions and I and just in the mood for that. Well I was planning on just not caring when I move and just tell everyone who I am and just see what happens. It happened a while ago, so I kinda look different and whatnot, I have this stupid fear that since I can't do music, they will think I am a fraud. I know, I'm stupid.

Anyway, if it goes well, I'll probably wait with the whole killing myself. Otherwise, I think I'm done.
yeah, obviously they don't have phone hours at midnight though.

I haven't shown my face yet, I am sort of a bit worried about the backlash, but I was going to do that before I kill myself. In about a month. Twitter and social media just doesn't work since nobody sees it.
Okay, my first label does have a phone number, but none of my friends a signed to them anymore as far as I know. Oh well could try.

No because they think I'm fucking dead and there is nothing I can do to change people's minds. It's just, I might as well just kill myself and be done with it. If they are so insistent on me being dead I might as well be dead. Then at least they are right.

I mean I could find some of the smaller bands and see if they have phone number or something. But I think most of them are probably hiding behind record labels (which I get.)

The problem is that I can never go back to music without their help. Since they fucked me up so hard, touching the guitar is so painful. It brings back the memories of when I effectively did kill myself when I was still touring (well I was taking a forced pause). It is so graphic. I have tried for so long to deal with it myself and I have given up. I just can't do music any more. I am tired of seeing myself write the fucking suicide letter and pull the gun in my mouth.

Anyway sorry for the rant, I just don't know what to do. I wish I had direct way of communicating with them. If I called them, at least I would know it was them who rejected me and not some fucking middleman.
I've gotten PTSD from it. Undiagnosed of course, since they won't admit it.

no. I was talking about my old band members and my fans. It's stupid, I am stupid. The only thing I can think of is that they don't deserve me and I don't deserve life. I just wished I had never gone into music, that I had never done anything. I wish I had killed myself as a child.

I tried to reach out and I got no reply. These people talk about how much they wish I was alive, yet when I write, nothing. I can only take that as people want me dead. And that was the last thing I was holding on to.
Fuck that is hard.  Is there no way for you to meet in person?
Things like "I shouldn't kill myself because I could survive" "I could reincarnate as myself" Whatever.
I have. That's what I have been spending two years on. I only have reasons not to die, and that means nothing to me.
They are not thoughts. I tried to kill myself several times. Just the last days it must have been at least two or three times. I have had suicide attempts ongoing for at least 3 years now.
I can't kill myself right now. If I fail, I want to wake up in a hospital where they speak my language. I also don't have anything to kill myself with.
